headline: RBI: UNSC Taliban Sanctions List amended for 5 entries; REs to act under UAPA s.51A
summary_points: RBI circulated MEA's intimation of UNSC press release SC/16494 (October 29, 2026) amending 5 entries on the 1988 Taliban Sanctions List.
Regulated entities must ensure no accounts exist in names of listed persons, as per Section 51A of UAPA, 1967 and Chapter IX of the RBI KYC Directions, 2025.
REs must follow the UAPA Order dated February 02, 2021 (amended April 22, 2024); delisting requests go to Joint Secretary (CTCR), MHA.
who_is_affected: Commercial banks, SFBs, payment banks, co-operative banks, RRBs, LABs, NBFCs, ARCs and AIFIs, particularly their compliance and KYC/AML teams.
action_required: Update sanction screening databases with the amended entries, screen existing accounts and follow the UAPA Order procedure for any match.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued circular RBI/2026-27/303 dated October 30, 2026 on implementation of Section 51A of the UAPA, 1967.

The circular relays the UNSC 1988 Committee's amendments to five entries on the Taliban Sanctions List (UNSC press release SC/16494 dated October 29, 2026), as informed by the MEA. The entries are TAi.007, TAi.024, TAi.026, TAi.082 and TAi.093.

What regulated entities should note:
- Ensure no account is held in the name of listed individuals or entities
- Follow Chapter IX of the RBI KYC Directions, 2025
- Follow the procedure in the UAPA Order dated February 02, 2021 (amended April 22, 2024)
- Forward any delisting requests electronically to Joint Secretary (CTCR), MHA

Banks, NBFCs, ARCs and AIFIs should refresh their sanctions screening lists promptly.

Please verify with the official RBI source before acting.
